method: MACE-MP-0 style benchmark reproduction from compact specification
definition: Use the provided benchmark setups for water RDF, adsorption scaling, and CRBH20 barriers to assess claim coverage of a universal atomistic foundation model.
assumptions: The text file is treated as the authoritative local benchmark specification.
Without shipped model weights, only configuration-level and reference-value analyses can be performed locally.
Figures will emphasize benchmark structure and quantitative targets rather than new model predictions.
invariants: Preserve the three named benchmark families.
Keep source-specific outputs for each family.
Report direct DFT barrier references in eV for the CRBH20 subset.
non_negotiable_steps: Parse the benchmark specification into structured data.
Generate figures tied to the named benchmark families.
State inability to run exact MACE-MP-0 inference if model weights are absent.
